purpose: Exactly one compatible DSP and one BRAM site per layer, at different XY locations.

circuit.packing_estimate_note: The original two-lane case packs 2 DSP, 2 BRAM, 6 CLB, 29 IO. Hard-block counts are expected from full-width modes; CLB/cluster estimates must be replaced by observed pack counts.

recommended_matrix.routing_width_note: Width 320 is a generous support smoke-test point, not a minimum-width or QoR claim; ordinary routing failure is not evidence of a layout-support bug.

targeted_checks: A cross-layer move must consider the target layer's only compatible site, even when its compressed index equals the source index.
Two DSPs and two physical BRAMs require both layers, so a resource class cannot silently disappear from candidate search.

acceptance.support: Packing and placement initialize without invalid grid assumptions; every placed cluster occupies a compatible unused slot; missing target-layer resources yield no move, not a crash.
acceptance.routing: Distinguish normal unroutable/congestion/timeout from assertion, invalid coordinate, resource mismatch, or RR-graph construction failure. A legal placement need not route at every chosen width.
acceptance.scale: The larger fixture tests stability on the same repeated lane topology, not generalization to an independent real design or production-scale timing/QoR.
